summary: Steel lookout tower on Arrowwood NWR, Stutsman County, erected 1936 and recorded as demolished; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Recorded as demolished, with the second tower (#2) listed beside it; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists both towers as removed.

notes_for_editor: The 1936 erection and the demolition rest on one compiled list (West Lookouts, which may derive from Ron Kemnow's ND list as cited by FFLA; that origin is not checked). Re-read 2026-10-10: the page has #1 and #2 entries, each reading '1936: A steel tower was erected.' then 'Demolished'. The FFLA list gives coordinates and Removed only. No builder, design, height or demolition date found. Searches of FWS and Wikipedia gave no tower detail. The ND archives inventory link (history.nd.gov/archives/manuscripts/inventory/11200.html) returned 404. The 1936 FWS release on CCC camps mentions lookout towers generically and does not name this refuge, so it is not cited. Record coordinates match the FFLA list.
